ecological_question: Do wetter conditions increase active-community richness by disproportionately recruiting species that are normally intermittent at that same route and seasonal survey window?
biological_hypothesis: Rainfall pulses disproportionately draw locally intermittent (satellite) species into the acoustically active assemblage, while locally persistent core species are less dependent on the pulse.
ecological_run_eligibility: Reuse the exact complete-10-stop, >=8-temperature-stop, plausible-temperature, parseable-date, unified-protocol, valid DaysSinceRain eligibility from NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.
pair_construction: Reuse exact State × RouteNumber × RunNumber adjacent-observed-year wetter/drier pairing from NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.

local_background.stratum: same State × RouteNumber × RunNumber as the focal pair
local_background.exclusion: Exclude both focal pair runs from the background calculation.
local_background.species_presence: Species is locally active in a background run if CallingIndex in {1,2,3} occurs at >=1 of that run's 10 sampled stops.
local_background.rationale: Measures local persistence in the same site and seasonal survey window rather than regional range size or pooled species prevalence.

event_definition.universe: For each wet/dry pair, species present in exactly one member of the pair.
event_definition.include_event_if: At least 3 valid background runs are available in the same route × RunNumber stratum after excluding the focal pair.

primary_pair_level_test.eligibility: Pairs with >=1 valid wet-only event and >=1 valid dry-only event.
primary_pair_level_test.statistic: delta_local_logit_prevalence = mean(logit prevalence of wet-only species) - mean(logit prevalence of dry-only species).
primary_pair_level_test.model: OLS intercept-only with cluster-robust SE by State:RouteNumber; each pair receives equal weight.
primary_pair_level_test.interpretation: Wet-only gains are locally more intermittent than dry-only losses within the same matched community transition.

pulse_strength_test.formula: delta ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
pulse_strength_test.prediction: beta_rain_contrast < 0; stronger rainfall contrasts preferentially recruit locally intermittent species.

event_level_sensitivity.model: Binomial-logit GLM wet_only ~ local_logit_prevalence + rain_contrast + local_logit_prevalence:rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(species)
event_level_sensitivity.interpretation: Tests the local-prevalence gradient after species-specific baseline propensity and pair-level covariates are included.

prior_only_sensitivity.background_rule: Recompute local prevalence using only eligible same-stratum runs with SurveyYear earlier than both focal pair years.
prior_only_sensitivity.purpose: Avoid using future observations to define local core/satellite status.

descriptive_classes.status: descriptive only; continuous prevalence is the inferential predictor.

decision_language.primary_negative: Supports rainfall-associated recruitment from the locally intermittent component of the active community.
decision_language.primary_null: Rainfall-associated reassembly is species-selective but not organized by local background persistence under this definition.
decision_language.interaction_negative: Supports stronger pulses preferentially drawing in locally intermittent species.

boundaries: Local prevalence is acoustic participation frequency, not occupancy probability.
Satellite/core language refers only to the acoustically active assemblage at a route × seasonal window.
Wet-only does not imply colonization and dry-only does not imply extinction.
The analysis is a post-opening ecological mechanism follow-up frozen before its own readback.
No causal rainfall claim is authorized.
